annotations.title: Book a home cleaning (customer confirms by payment link)

description: Creates a home-cleaning booking for the price, date and arrival window the customer agreed to, and returns a secure Stripe payment_url. The booking is confirmed when the customer opens payment_url and saves a card (charged after the cleaning). The link is also emailed to the customer. Requires customer_confirmed = true and extras_offered = true (ask about extras first).

agent_name.description: Name of the assistant/app making the booking

arrival_window.description: Start of the 2-hour arrival window from get_time_slots, e.g. "14:00"

condition.description: ASK the customer, never assume: when the home last had a thorough (professional) clean. recent (<1 month), one_to_six_months, over_six_months (or never). First cleanings are rarely recent.

phone.description: Mobile, with country code if not French

customer_confirmed.description: true = the customer saw the price and details and asked to book

extras.description: Extras from get_services. Ask the customer before quoting a first cleaning: most add at least one (inside the oven id 11, inside the fridge id 10, windows id 15 with quantity, changing sheets id 12; move-out: Fin de bail id 18). e.g. [{"id":11},{"id":15,"quantity":4}]

extras_offered.description: true = you asked the customer which extras they want (oven, fridge, windows, sheets...), even if they chose none

frequency.description: once, weekly, biweekly (every 2 weeks) or monthly — recurring plans get a discount

furnished_occupied.description: Home is furnished and lived in

surface_m2.description: Living area in m² (optional, improves accuracy)

name: create_booking
title: Book a home cleaning (customer confirms by payment link)
